'''Justahl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Vice President/Legends|Vice President]] of a company. He wore [[spectacles]] and dressed in a [[Dervdisi fashioned suit]]. Justahl once scheduled a meeting with several other individuals, and seemed to be late to the meeting. One of the attendees stated that if Justahl did not arrive on time, then his share options would be given to [[Kemends]]. In order to make the meeting on time and make an entrance, Justahl used a [[Hush-About AJP-400]] [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] to arrive at the meeting room which was located 200 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] above the ground.<ref name="GFT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Justahl first appeared in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' and was later mentioned in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''.
